description:
This exceptional two-bedroom apartment is located on the third floor of The Locks, Charlemont Square, Dublin 2

The Locks is one of Dublin 2’s most prestigious and sought-after new developments, ideally positioned within the vibrant Charlemont Square district on Charlemont Street, between the Grand Canal and Harcourt Street. This landmark mixed-use scheme by the renowned McGarrell Reilly Group connects some of Dublin’s most desirable neighbourhoods, including Ranelagh, Rathmines, and Portobello, while sitting at the heart of Dublin’s most dynamic social and cultural districts.

Set around a beautifully designed public plaza, residents benefit from an on-site supermarket, cafés, restaurants, and retail spaces, offering unparalleled convenience in a truly urban setting.

Apartment Overview
Apartment No. 14 is an impeccably designed, light-filled A2-rated two-bedroom residence extending to approximately 1,000 sq.ft.

The entrance hall leads to a spacious bright living and dining area, opening onto a private winter balcony with tranquil views

A standout feature of the property is the fully enclosed winter garden with bi-folding doors, offering a versatile space ideal as a home office, additional lounge, or playroom.

The high-specification kitchen is located just off the living area and features floor-to-ceiling cabinetry, quartz worktops, and a full suite of integrated Siemens appliances, including a dishwasher, oven, microwave, and full-height fridge/freezer. A separate utility room provides excellent additional storage and includes a washing machine and dryer.

Both double bedrooms are generously proportioned with excellent fitted wardrobe space. The principal bedroom benefits from a large ensuite bathroom, while a stylish main bathroom serves the second bedroom and guests. Both bathrooms are finished to an exceptional standard with Villeroy & Boch sanitary ware, rain showers, heated towel rails, and premium tiling throughout.

Additional features include wood flooring throughout, high-quality furnishings, and expansive floor-to-ceiling glazing that maximises natural light throughout the apartment. The property is further enhanced by its A2 BER rating, ensuring excellent energy efficiency and comfort.

Location
The Locks enjoys a prime Dublin 2 location just moments from St. Stephen’s Green, Harcourt Street, and Dublin’s premier retail and dining districts.

The nearby villages of Ranelagh and Rathmines are within a short six-minute walk, offering an extensive range of cafés, restaurants, and local amenities.

Transport connectivity is exceptional, with the Charlemont Luas stop only a three-minute walk away, alongside multiple Dublin Bus routes serving the area. GoCar and Dublin Bikes facilities are also located adjacent to Charlemont Square.

Residents enjoy immediate access to scenic walking routes along the Grand Canal, as well as nearby green spaces including St. Stephen’s Green and Iveagh Gardens.

The development’s central plaza features landscaped gardens, an outdoor playground, fitness equipment, bicycle parking, and thoughtfully designed communal spaces.

Key Features
Spacious 2-bedroom apartment (approx. 1,000 sq.ft)
Sixth-floor position with courtyard garden views
A2 BER energy rating
Private enclosed winter garden
Floor-to-ceiling glazing throughout
Bespoke kitchen with quartz countertops
Integrated Siemens appliances
Separate utility room with washer/dryer
Excellent built-in storage throughout
Spacious double bedrooms with fitted wardrobes
Luxurious Villeroy & Boch bathrooms
Rain showers and heated towel rails
High-quality flooring and contemporary finishes

Development Features & Amenities
-	Concierge and management suite
-	Parcel collection service
-	Future shared car service
-	Tesco supermarket
-	Maser Art Studio
-	Dry cleaning service
-	Housekeeping service
-	Dedicated resident app for Android/iPhone
-       Yoga Dublin
-       McCauleys Pharmacy
-       Jaqi Interiors
-       Vanilla Hair Studio
-      Carved Cafe

This outstanding apartment offers a rare opportunity to enjoy modern luxury living in one of Dublin’s most connected and vibrant residential developments, combining premium design, extensive amenities, and an unbeatable city-centre location.
